metadata.methods_description: MEG data were acquired and subsequently converted to BIDS format using MNE-BIDS. Anatomical T1-weighted MRI images were processed using FreeSurfer's recon-all pipeline with default parameters. Additional FreeSurfer processing included scalp surface generation (mne make_scalp_surfaces) and watershed-based boundary element model computation (mne watershed_bem). Forward models were computed from source space definitions, head-MRI transformation matrices, and conductor models.
